config.grain_rationale: One record is one QBCC licence held by a licensee. The business participant is the licensee (the holder legal person); the licence number, licence grade, licence class and financial category describe the licence itself, not the business, so they are left unmapped.

record_id.rationale: The CKAN datastore row id is unique per record in the discovery partition (508/508 distinct); Licence Number has duplicate rows (506/508). _id is the traceable record key, not a business identifier.

fields.rationale: Column is 'Licensee Name' - a licence is issued to a legal person, so the licensee is the holder's legal name. Values are registered-style names (e.g. 'FLASH AIR CONDITIONING AND ELECTRICAL PTY LTD', 'NICHOLAS JAMES LALOT').
Licence Type DESC explicitly states the licensee's legal form: 'Individual' -> sole_trader, 'Company' -> company. Only these two values observed; everything else defaults to unknown.
Column 'ABN', values shape '99 999 999 999', 99.6% checksum-valid over 279 populated values - genuine ABNs. Checksum transform rejects the remainder (1 invalid value observed).
Column 'ACN', values shape '999 999 999', 100% checksum-valid over 34 populated values. Mapped as its own column only; never derived from ABN.
Full business address as stated in the one free-text address column.

Address strings consistently end with '<STATE> <POSTCODE>' (e.g. 'Toorbul QLD 4510'); the state token is extracted from that tail rather than assumed as a constant. Anchored to end-of-string so street-name abbreviations are not matched.
4-digit postcode is the trailing token of the address after the state abbreviation.

constants.rationale: Queensland Building and Construction Commission register of Australian licensees; all addresses carry Australian state abbreviations and 4-digit postcodes.

unmapped.reason: CKAN datastore row identifier; used as record_id only, not a business identifier.
Identifier of the licence, not of the business. Not mapped to any entity identifier.
Coded form ('I'/'C') of Licence Type DESC, which is already used for entity_type; redundant.
Describes the licence (e.g. Trade Contractor Licence, Site Supervisor), not the legal entity.
Trade/occupational class of the licence (e.g. Carpentry, Gasfitting); not an ANZSIC industry code, so not entity.industry_code.
Financial category of the licence; constant in this partition and not an entity attribute.
Code form of Financial Category DESC; licence attribute, not an entity field.

config.notes: Source is a CKAN datastore_search JSON envelope (help/value/result.records); records are read from result.records. No observation or validity dates are exposed by the source, so observed_at falls back to dataset metadata modified and no valid_from/valid_to is emitted. No trading-name column exists, so entity.trading_name is not populated. Licence status is not present in this file; entity.status is therefore left unmapped rather than inferred. address.state/postcode resolve for 503/508 records; the remaining 5 have non-standard address tails and are left unset rather than guessed.
